source_context: GPT-6 / ChatGPT is developing the classical Banks sensitivity theorem under the user's request. This draft phase proves the positive finite-orbit separation and orbit avoidance results already accepted by the receiver, then uses Mathlib's periodicOrbit, minimalPeriod, and dense-set APIs to construct two disjoint full periodic orbits on an infinite metric space with dense periodic points. The next intended step is the continuous/topologically-transitive sensitivity conclusion. This submission does not claim the full theorem is proved. All statements and proofs were machine authored.
